name: AStra M1 curated sample Git commits
source: Synthetic, locally generated Git commits modeling controller, middleware, unrelated-file, and dynamic-route changes; not an external open-source benchmark corpus.

cases.description: A controller dependency gains a required parameter.
Authorization middleware changes behavior for a protected controller route.
A response adds a harmless informational field.
Documentation changes while an unrelated controller remains untouched.
A dependency used by a dynamically composed route changes.
